Exactly what I need it. Easy to install and it allows me to storage all cleaning and laundry products without having to mount wall shelves and being scare they might fall down with the weight. Nice if you rent so you don't have to mess with them walls. If you have a laundry closet (like me), be mainful of assemble it inside the closet or make sure it clears the door dimensions if you rather assembling it outaide and them bri g it in. I had to take it partially apart to bring it inside the closet and put it back together again inside. Also, I have a stepper storaged next to the washer so I can reach things from the top shelves (I am 5'2").
Great item. Looks complex to construct but really easy.
Sturdy versatile easy to assemble. Would recommend.

The item is well designed and painted, but it is light duty, from the thin narrow poles to the wire shelves, to the hanging bar. This is a barely adequate shelving system for the laundry area, with light storage requirements. It's priced accordingly.
